params.locator: Indexed abstract and archived full-text Table 1 at p. 206

note: The published odds ratio and both Wald interval limits correspond exactly at the printed precision to 2/615 inside-observer exposures and 6/6,578 male trainee exposures. The same calculation with 6/6,657 trainee exposures gives 3.617 (0.728–17.958). The registry preserves both the male and sex-combined trainee source strata. The abstract does not explicitly tie the reported odds ratio to the male-only group. The earlier archived full-text extraction identifies ten observers contributing 615 exposures and excludes five trainee records missing demographic data. A new public full-text download was unavailable.
